title: Structural Coherence Evaluation for Physical Theories: A Theory-Agnostic Framework with Observation-Native Ontology and Self-Imposed Falsifiability
abstract: Presents a theory-agnostic evaluation framework to assess structural coherence and falsifiability of physical theories without privileging any paradigm. It operationalizes four principles (observation-native ontology, declared structural vulnerability, priced adaptation, primitive transparency) via five structural metrics and a graph-based implementation, including self-imposed falsifiability through forbidden observational patterns.
